info.abstract:
[Type] Metadata Access
[Behaviour] Request or set the service status.
[Parameters] - status : new service status, 'up' or 'down'. - level : use level "1" (default) to ask for service status only; use level "2" to ask for job list. - enable : list of the users to be enabled; use "all" to enable all users. - disable : list of the users to be disabled; use "all" to disable all users. - farm_size : new value for SERVER_FARM_SIZE; use "0" for infinity. - queue_size : new value for QUEUE_SIZE; use "0" for infinity. - task_limit : new value for TASK_LIMIT; use "0" for infinity. - core_limit : new value for CORE_LIMIT; use "0" for infinity. - sched_policy : new value for SCHED_POLICY. - log_type : new value for log level.
[System parameters] - objkey_filter : filter on the output of the operator written to file (default=all => no filter, none => no output). service_status : show service status as text; service_tasks : show the list of running tasks.
[Examples] Enable the service: OPH_TERM: oph_service status=up; SUBMISSION STRING: "operator=oph_service;status=up;"
